title: 第二十二章 初入句余山
novel_title: 穿书被杀妻证道？魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
冲出江氏集团的大楼，他犹不安心，对着路边疯狂挥手叫出租车。

    下一秒，一杆血色大戟后发先至，戟刃相交，发出一道巨大轰鸣。

    故海渊停下曲音，盘膝而坐，运转血灵之力，吞噬秘境的死气，开始冲击元婴中期。

    即使自己再辛劳，可当接到赵宇哲电话的这一刻起，似乎所有的疲倦都在顷刻间烟消云散了。

    后来，段大雄花了三百两纹银，从别人手中买了一本，满足了妻子的心愿。

    这跟战气的量无关，而是高顺对战气的运用能力，要明显超出刘烨一个层次，这是天赋问题。

    众人已经开始沉浸在了胜利的喜悦当中，只有莫妮卡还在眼都不眨一下的看着屏幕。

    可是他没有料到，他没查到张肃刑什么，前几日张肃刑却自己过来找他了。

    箭矢犹如电蛇闪电般朝哥布林最后面的祭祀射去，在有效范围内，它没有任何规避的可能。

    听到他竟然这么说，而且还说曹古、党和玉两人勾结另外三个家族。

    一旁的薛晓妮见状，顿时怒火填膺，想也不想，伸手就把李睿给挡在了身后。

    如果李辰身处他的位置，恐怕也是同样的想法，一个世界观的建立花了三十年，不可能轻易被李辰一句话瓦解殆尽。

    一开始，他并没有把大嘴的话放在心上，但现在他信了，如果毒岛真的一直存在，并且隐藏于世人的眼皮底下，那么岛主绝对不会比他以前差，也有能力找他报仇。
content_en:
After rushing out of the Jiang Group building, he still felt uneasy and waved frantically at the roadside to hail a taxi.

    The next second, a bloody halberd arrived first, and the blades of the halberds intersected, making a huge roar.

    Therefore, Haiyuan stopped singing, sat cross-legged, and used the power of the blood spirit to swallow the death energy of the secret realm and begin to attack the middle stage of Nascent Soul.

    No matter how hard I worked, from the moment I received Zhao Yuzhe's call, it seemed that all the fatigue disappeared in an instant.

    Later, Duan Daxiong spent three hundred taels of silver to buy a copy from someone else, fulfilling his wife's wish.

    This has nothing to do with the amount of fighting spirit, but Gao Shun's ability to use fighting spirit, which is obviously a level higher than Liu Ye. This is a matter of talent.

    Everyone was already immersed in the joy of victory. Only Monica was still looking at the screen without blinking.

    But he didn't expect that he didn't find anything about Zhang Suxing, but Zhang Suxing came to find him himself a few days ago.

    The arrow shot towards the Goblin priest at the back like an electric snake and lightning. Within the effective range, there was no possibility of evasion.

    I heard him actually say that, and also said that Cao Gu, Dang and Yu colluded with three other families.

    Seeing this, Xue Xiaoni on the side was filled with anger. Without thinking, she reached out and blocked Li Rui behind her.

    If Li Chen were in his position, I'm afraid he would have the same idea. It took thirty years to build a worldview, and it cannot be easily destroyed by Li Chen's words.

    At first, he didn't take Big Mouth's words to heart, but now he believes it. If the Poison Island really exists all the time and is hidden under the eyes of the world, then the island owner will definitely not be worse than he was before, and he will be able to seek revenge from him.
